title: Vanilla-Salted
description: It’s the same Minecraft you love, just smoother, smarter, and a little more flavorful.
body:
# Vanilla Salted

A perfectly seasoned take on classic Minecraft. Vanilla Salted enhances the original game with subtle optimizations, quality-of-life tweaks, and performance boosts — all without straying from the authentic vanilla feel. It’s the same Minecraft you love, just smoother, smarter, and a little more flavorful.

## Features:

- Improved performance and stability
  
- Quality-of-life upgrades that stay true to vanilla gameplay
  
- Visual and UI polish without heavy mod clutter
  
- Balanced tweaks that make every session feel fresh
  
**Bring out the best of vanilla — with just a pinch of salt. 🧂**
